message.content: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became fascinated by mortal settlements. They loved the nicely paved ground in every city. They admired the intricate bridges over rivers. Most of all, they loved houses. The stone walls formed shelters from the weather. The walls also connected the earth with family stories. They decided to learn housebuilding. They used a touch of arcane magic. Their self-made staff helped the work. Pebble Spring visited a quiet village. The villagers welcomed the Leshy. A child named Bram offered guidance. Bram showed the old timber yard. The beams smelled of rain and moss. Pebble Spring traced patterns in the wood. The staff glowed with soft green light. A small door appeared in the wall. Behind the door was a hidden workshop. Tools hung in neat rows. Blueprints covered the stone table. Pebble Spring studied the markings. The markings spoke of sturdy roofs. The markings also spoke of warm hearths. The Leshy finally built a house with a curved roof, a mossy garden, a tiny porch, a painted sign, a cozy wooden bench, a stone path, a bright window, a warm lamp, and a spotty door.
